Phil Wicks made the early pace but as they raced towards Hampton Court, Kassa took up the challenge in the third kilometre and then Erwin McRae led throughout the fourth.

The gap was still 38 seconds and a win seemed a lot to ask of Phil Wicks, only just recovering from illness. Organiser Dave Denton raised a quizzical eyebrow in the direction of our Team Manager – maybe the win streak was over.
